final: WITH customer_orders AS (SELECT o.customer_id, c.gender, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM Orders AS o JOIN Customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY o.customer_id, c.gender), gender_totals AS (SELECT gender, SUM(order_count) AS total_orders FROM customer_orders GROUP BY gender), ratios AS (SELECT co.customer_id, co.gender, co.order_count, 1.0 * co.order_count / gt.total_orders AS ratio FROM customer_orders AS co JOIN gender_totals AS gt ON co.gender = gt.gender), average_ratio AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM ratios) SELECT r.customer_id, r.gender, r.order_count, r.ratio, r.ratio - a.avg_ratio AS difference FROM ratios AS r CROSS JOIN average_ratio AS a WHERE r.ratio > a.avg_ratio ORDER BY difference DESC LIMIT 10
